scheme2_name: National Scholarship for Post Graduate Studies (NSPG)

comparisons.scheme2_value: Meritorious students from economically weaker sections pursuing first PG degree

comparisons.scheme1_value: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to bank account every 4 months
comparisons.scheme2_value: Monthly stipend for 10 months via PFMS (Public Financial Management System)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Must own cultivable land in own name; Income Tax payers excluded; no constitutional posts/government employees
comparisons.scheme2_value: First PG degree only; under 30 years; enrolled full-time in recognised PG programme; first year of study

comparisons.scheme1_value: Income Tax payers, government employees (serving/retired), politicians, pensioners earning Rs. 10,000+/month, professionals (doctors, lawyers, engineers)
comparisons.scheme2_value: Those who completed any PG degree already; age 30+; part-time students; students not in first year

comparisons.scheme1_value: Aadhaar Card, landholding papers, savings bank account details
comparisons.scheme2_value: Mark sheets (class 9 onwards), PG admission letter, ID proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID/Passport/PAN), bank details, 2 passport photos

comparisons.scheme1_value: Online via pmkisan.gov.in: Aadhaar + mobile OTP → fill form → upload documents → submit (can also apply via CSCs)
comparisons.scheme2_value: Online via scholarships.gov.in: registration with OTP → eKYC with FaceAuth (generate OTR ID) → fill form → submit → institute verification → state verification

comparisons.scheme1_value: No fixed deadline — registration stays open year-round
comparisons.scheme2_value: NSP announces opening/closing dates annually; missing renewal cut-off forfeits that year (not permanent debarment)

comparisons.scheme1_value: 3 installments per year (every 4 months) — no fixed dates given
comparisons.scheme2_value: Monthly for 10 months per year; track on PFMS 'Know Your Payment'

comparisons.scheme1_value: If ANY family member paid Income Tax, the ENTIRE family becomes ineligible
comparisons.scheme2_value: Second PG degrees are NOT funded; you can only get this scholarship for your first postgraduate degree

comparisons.scheme1_value: Land must be in YOUR name; sharecropping/renting others' land doesn't qualify
comparisons.scheme2_value: Missing annual renewal deadline loses scholarship for that year (though you aren't permanently barred)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Bank account MUST be Aadhaar-seeded; if not, installments fail
comparisons.scheme2_value: Bank account required; no specific Aadhaar-seeding mentioned

comparisons.scheme1_value: Single-level: applicant submits, UIDAI Aadhaar verification automatic
comparisons.scheme2_value: Two-level: institute verification + State Higher Education Department/State Nodal Agency verification (chase both if delayed)
No helpline given; contact via scholarships.gov.in and UGC website

recommendation:

🌾 **Choose PM-KISAN if:** You own cultivable farmland in your name and want income support for agricultural inputs and household needs.

📚 **Choose NSPG if:** You are a talented student from an economically weaker background pursuing your first postgraduate degree (Masters) and are under 30 years old.
